description: This Python source file defines classes and methods related to Amazon Stability 3 image generation using AWS Bedrock API. It includes configuration, model support checks, request transformation, response handling, and cost calculation. The file is specific to the Amazon Stability 3 image generation model within the project's image generation modules.

classes.name: AmazonStability3Config
classes.description: Configuration and utility methods for Amazon Stability 3 image generation models.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Returns configuration parameters for the class.

methods.name: List get_supported_openai_params(cls, model: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Returns an empty list as no additional OpenAI parameters are supported for Stability 3.

methods.name: bool _is_stability_3_model(cls, model: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Checks if a given model name matches known Stability 3 or Ultra models.

methods.name: AmazonStability3TextToImageRequest transform_request_body( cls, text: str, optional_params: dict )
methods.description: Transforms input text and optional parameters into a request object for Stability 3 models.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params(cls, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Bedrock parameters, returns optional_params directly.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_response_dict_to_openai_response( cls, model_response: ImageResponse, response_dict: dict )
methods.description: Converts the response dictionary from Stability 3 API into an OpenAI-style response object and handles errors.

methods.name: float cost_calculator( cls, model: str, image_response: ImageResponse, size: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Calculates the cost of the image generation based on model info, number of images, and cost per image.
